# Tricholand — Vivero Productor Mayorista B2B de Trichocereus

> Specialist B2B wholesale nursery producing Trichocereus (San Pedro, Peruvian Torch, Achuma, Terscheckii, Spachianus, Macrogonus, Bridgesii) and columnar cacti in Murcia, Spain. Direct wholesale supply to European and UK nurseries, garden centers, landscapers and botanical distributors with EU Plant Passport included.

## Key Facts

- **Business type:** B2B wholesale cactus producer & grower (not retail)
- **Location:** Murcia, Spain (Mediterranean greenhouse & open-field cultivation)
- **Contact:** info@tricholand.com
- **Minimum wholesale order:** 750 units per variety (additional lots of 150 units) or 50-unit mixed sample pack (5 varieties × 10 units) for first-time professional buyers
- **Phytosanitary certification:** EU Plant Passport included on every shipment; export documentation available for UK and non-EU European destinations
- **Markets served:** Spain, UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Portugal, Belgium, Austria, Switzerland and EU-27
- **Languages:** ES, EN, DE, FR, NL, IT, PT
